name: roll_forward_identity
description: end value = round((prev value + net flows) x (1 + product return)), tolerance 1 rupee

name: roll_forward_exact
description: same identity with zero tolerance (informational: rounding of the stored return)

name: switch_pairs_balance
description: every switch_out has a switch_in on the next txn_id: same client, date, amount, different product

name: deposits_withdrawals_on_cash
description: deposits and withdrawals attach to the Cash product

name: no_txn_after_closed_date
description: no transaction dated after the client's closed_date

name: no_interaction_after_closed_date
description: no interaction dated after the client's closed_date

name: no_holdings_from_closure_month_end
description: closed clients have no holdings from the closure month-end onward (KPI: AUM is 0 there)

name: no_revenue_from_closure_month_end
description: closed clients have no revenue row from the closure month-end onward

name: no_holdings_before_onboarding
description: no holdings before the onboarding month-end

name: revenue_formula
description: fee_revenue = sum(market_value x fee_pct / 100 / 12) within half a rupee (rounding), one row per client with holdings

name: segment_matches_onboarding_aum
description: segment follows the onboarding_aum bands (25 lakh and 5 crore fall in HNI)

name: dim_date_coverage
description: 1461 contiguous days, and every fact date lies inside the table

name: no_orphans_in_mart
description: no fact row points at a missing client (FKs enforce this; this proves it independently)

name: no_nulls_and_negatives
description: no NULL KYC, no non-positive amount, no negative market value in the mart
